holidays.name: National Poultry Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate chickens, turkeys, ducks, and every feathered creature that ends up on the dinner table. Fire up the fryer, roast a bird, or simply tip your hat to the humble drumstick.
holidays.origin: National Poultry Day is observed in the United States on March 19 and is believed to have been created by poultry industry supporters to promote the nutritional value and versatility of poultry. Its exact founder is unclear.
holidays.funFact: Chickens outnumber humans on Earth by more than 3 to 1, with roughly 25 billion alive at any given time.

holidays.name: National Let's Laugh Day
holidays.description: A day dedicated to chuckling, giggling, and guffawing. Share a terrible dad joke, watch a comedy, or laugh at yourself for no reason at all.
holidays.origin: This unofficial holiday encourages people to use laughter as a way to relieve stress and boost wellbeing. It is popularly observed on March 19, though its original creator is not well documented.
holidays.funFact: Laughter is contagious because of mirror neurons in the brain, and rats have been shown to 'laugh' in ultrasonic chirps when tickled.

holidays.name: Swallows Return to Capistrano Day
holidays.description: Legend says the cliff swallows fly back to Mission San Juan Capistrano in California each year on St. Joseph's Day. The town throws a festival with music, parades, and plenty of bird-themed fun.
holidays.origin: The tradition dates back to the mission's early history and was popularized by the 1939 song 'When the Swallows Come Back to Capistrano', which turned the migration into a national legend.
holidays.funFact: The swallows really do migrate about 6,000 miles from Argentina, but in recent decades they have been arriving less reliably at the mission, so the town's tradition is sometimes more punctual than the birds.

holidays.name: National Certified Nurses Day
holidays.description: A day to thank the specially certified nurses who bring expert skill and care to patients everywhere. Bring snacks to the nursing station and say thanks.
holidays.origin: Established by the American Nurses Credentialing Center to recognize nurses who have earned specialty certification, demonstrating advanced knowledge in their field.
holidays.funFact: Becoming a certified nurse often requires passing a rigorous exam on top of clinical hours, and the date was chosen to coincide with a week celebrating nursing excellence.

holidays.name: Kick Butts Day Season / Quirky Day: Poultry and Sprinkles Appreciation – International Sticker Day Observance
holidays.description: A playful observance of all things stuck, stuck-on, and sticky. Slap a sticker on something that does not need one and call it art.
holidays.origin: Sticker lovers on social media popularized the date as a loose celebration of adhesive art and collecting, with no official founder.
holidays.funFact: The modern pressure-sensitive sticker was invented in 1935 by R. Stanton Avery, who started with a machine that made self-adhesive labels.
